metadata.title: Cluster structures from Legendrian double twist knots: a comparative approach
metadata.abstract: We undertake a systematic comparison of cluster algebras associated to Legendrian knots of the same smooth knot type. We describe a cluster structure on the m-graded augmentation variety of Legendrian representatives of a family of double twist knots that includes all orientably Lagrangian fillable twist knots. For different Legendrian representatives of the same smooth knot type, we show that these cluster structures are equivalent. Along the way, we characterize the representatives that admit Maslov-m exact Lagrangian fillings, construct a Catalan number of such fillings for each representative, and show that any Maslov-0 fillable representative is Legendrian isotopic to the (-1)-framed closure of a positive braid. Finally, we give two Legendrian representatives of a cabled twist knot that yield equivalent cluster structures of infinite type.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.progressType: Legendrian 双扭结的 cluster 结构比较
analysis.workSummary: 为双扭 Legendrian 结的分次 augmentation variety 描述 cluster 结构，证明同光滑结型若干代表的结构等价，刻画 Maslov-m 填充并构造 Catalan 数目精确 Lagrangian 填充。
analysis.breakthrough: 联系不同 Legendrian 代表的代数结构和可填充性。
analysis.limitations: 结构等价不等于 Legendrian 同痕；正 braid 闭包结论要求 Maslov-0 可填充。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露生成式 AI 编写证明定理 7.3 所需的 Sage 代码以生成突变序列；其余内容的构思、写作和证明未使用生成式 AI。
